name: Hobbies
overview: Scripture encourages believers to engage wholeheartedly in their activities, doing whatever their hand finds to do with might, recognizing that opportunity for work and wisdom ends with death (Ecclesiastes 9:10). However, Christians are warned against placing their ultimate value in earthly treasures or divided loyalties, as one cannot serve both God and worldly wealth (Matthew 6:19, 24). Instead, believers are called to live as holy sacrifices to God, investing in eternal treasures that cannot be corrupted or stolen (Romans 12:1; Luke 12:33), while remembering that all authority belongs to Christ (Matthew 28:18). This perspective frames hobbies and leisure as opportunities to glorify God rather than serve selfish interests.
